scope: Bounded request-relative mapping of server delivery completion
method: Given an identity-correlated request, use native roundtrip and server receive/return durations to bound a server mark relative to native request start; never subtract absolute cross-process clocks
limits: The supplied error allowance must cover rate error and quantization over the request
Current correlated diagnostic uses a one-ms quantization allowance, not a measured live drift bound
Bounds are not clock synchronization or an exact network split
Five-stage attribution and live capacity remain unproven
